observations.description: Section19 and its continuation have highly compressed word spacing in the supplied English and Arabic text. This is present in the private source, remains readable at full size, and is separate from the new footer. No inter-line collision or clipped text identified.
observations.pixel_comparison_note: Strict Poppler body pixels differ slightly because coordinates serialize with sub-millipoint precision changes (maximum 0.000251pt); the compressed spacing is visibly present in the original source.

observations.description: Legacy public one-page form retains low-resolution raster contact/legal text supplied in its original footer. New address text is crisp and does not intersect those items.

original_blank_and_filled_report.inspection_details: All19 original full pages reviewed in five labelled contact sheets; all19 enlarged footer crops reviewed in five footer sheets. Dense terms pages5,6,9 additionally reviewed at full native144dpi, and signature footer enlarged. All14 pages with rendered long English/Arabic answers reviewed in four new contact sheets; remaining22 filled pages are pixel-identical to originals already inspected. Populated signature Arabic page1 and terms Arabic page11/English page13 additionally inspected at full144dpi. Local Fontconfig configuration/cache diagnostics are documented independently from PDF defects; there were no PDF syntax or decoder diagnostics.
original_blank_and_filled_report.environment_note: The bundled Poppler runtime cannot load its default Fontconfig configuration/cache in this sandbox. Six successful render processes emitted environment-only diagnostics; all55 page images were produced and inspected or compared pixel-for-pixel as documented.
